scope: CLI generator invalid JSON value classification; no external persistence or deployment claims

wholeRepositoryMerge: All existing type, lint, format, coverage, security and required CI gates must pass; no threshold, test, exclusion or policy weakening
limits: One isolated writer; no new services or paid provision, no network model loading; no Rust source or persistence changes
